university.name: University of Derby
university.summary: The University of Derby teaches from a Derby campus, with course pages naming Markeaton Street and the Cavendish Building. Its Pakistan page states that applying through an agent is optional, and its scholarships page lists self-funded international awards that are applied automatically.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.overview: A three-year, full-time computing degree at the Derby campus. Year 1 covers computing fundamentals, with specialist modules in Year 2 and optional modules in the final year.
courses.academic_requirements: September 2027 entry: 112 UCAS points; A level BBC; T Level Merit; BTEC DMM; GCSE Maths and English grade 4/C or equivalent.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall, with at least 5.5 in each skills area.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page states students completing A levels or the IB at international schools in Pakistan can begin from the first year of a bachelor's degree, with specific requirements on course pages. It also states: we will not be accepting Medium of Instruction evidence for English language.
courses.career_notes: The course page lists software engineer, project manager, technical architect, chief technology officer and product manager.
courses.notes: Fee is the 2026/27 international fee; target year fee not yet published. Entry requirements are listed for September 2026 and September 2027 entry. Module names are not shown on the page. The page gives no separate international academic requirements.

courses.title: Business Management
courses.overview: A three-year, full-time business degree at the Derby campus that the course page states is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute, with a common first year across Business Management degrees.
courses.academic_requirements: September 2027 entry: 112 UCAS points; A level BBC; T Level Merit; BTEC DMM; GCSE Maths and English grade 4/C or equivalent.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 with at least 5.5 in each skills area.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page states students completing A levels or the IB at international schools in Pakistan can begin from the first year of a bachelor's degree, with specific requirements on course pages. It also states: we will not be accepting Medium of Instruction evidence for English language.
courses.career_notes: The course page lists areas including project management, consultancy, operations, human resource management, marketing and finance, and further study options of the MBA Global and MSc International Business.
courses.notes: Fee is the 2026/27 international fee; target year fee not yet published. Entry requirements are listed for September 2026 and September 2027 entry. Module names are not shown on the page.

courses.title: Management
courses.overview: A taught master's in Derby International Business School combining online and face-to-face teaching, covering management theory, people management, supply chains, finance and risk, and ending with a business research project.
courses.academic_requirements: An undergraduate degree with a minimum 2:2 classification or international equivalent.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.5 overall, with 6.0 in each skills area.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page states postgraduate applicants need a relevant bachelor's degree from a recognised Pakistani university equivalent to at least a UK 2:2; applicants with a two or three year bachelor's must also hold a master's; a four-year honours degree with a minimum GPA of 2.4/4.00 will be considered. It also states: we will not be accepting Medium of Instruction evidence for English language.
courses.career_notes: The course page describes preparation for management roles across private, public and not-for-profit sectors.
courses.notes: Fee of 17,500 is stated for the full course for 2026/27; the page notes fees may rise after one year. Page lists September and January starts without years, so no intake label is recorded. Module names are not shown. Location field on the page is blank.

courses.title: Advanced Data Science
courses.duration_text: 1 year full-time with a September start, 18 months with a January start; part-time 2 years
courses.overview: A taught master's at the Derby campus for graduates of STEM or closely related subjects with significant mathematical content, designed to meet academic requirements for Chartered IT Professional status.
courses.academic_requirements: A 2.2 or higher bachelor's degree in a STEM or closely related discipline with significant mathematical content, or an equivalent international degree.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall or equivalent; per-skill bands not shown.
courses.experience_requirements: Applicants without the degree may qualify with relevant work experience in a management or supervisory position, with employer references and an interview; no minimum length shown.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The Pakistan page states postgraduate applicants need a relevant bachelor's degree from a recognised Pakistani university equivalent to at least a UK 2:2; applicants with a two or three year bachelor's must also hold a master's; a four-year honours degree with a minimum GPA of 2.4/4.00 will be considered. It also states: we will not be accepting Medium of Instruction evidence for English language.
courses.career_notes: The course page lists business intelligence and data analytics, consultancy and entrepreneurship, and PhD level study.
courses.notes: Fee of 17,500 is stated for the full course for 2026/27. Page lists September and January starts without years, so no intake label is recorded. Module list on the page is empty. Per-skill English bands not shown.

scholarships.name: Vice-Chancellor's Scholarship
scholarships.summary: An automatic tuition fee reduction for self-funded overseas fee-paying students on full-time taught or MRes programmes at a Derby campus, stated on the CAS letter.
scholarships.criteria_text: Self-funding overseas fee-paying student; not for students fully sponsored by a third party. Excludes accelerated programmes and PhD or MPhil. Cannot be held with GREAT, Chevening or Commonwealth awards or combined with the alumni discount; can be combined with the Full Payment Discount.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated; no application needed.
scholarships.intake_label: April 2026, September 2026 or January 2027 (2027 terms not yet published)
scholarships.notes: Awarded on enrolment per the page; requires_offer is inferred from the award being stated on the CAS letter. September 2027 is not listed among the intakes.

scholarships.name: Biomedical Science Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 1,000 towards tuition plus a GBP 500 conference contribution
scholarships.summary: A scholarship for students in financial need who hold an offer for MSc Biomedical Science or MRes Molecular Medicine, with preference for those interested in cancer treatment research.
scholarships.criteria_text: Student in financial need holding an offer for MSc Biomedical Science or MRes Molecular Medicine; preference for interest in cancer treatment research.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated; applied for through an online form.
scholarships.notes: Page lists no countries. Intake and deadline not stated.

scholarships.name: OPM Alumni Scholarship for Business and Social Impact
scholarships.value_text: GBP 7,000, with quarterly mentoring from Harvard Business School OPM alumni
scholarships.summary: A scholarship for Derby graduates holding an MBA offer, with preference for under-represented backgrounds, first-generation students and those with financial need.
scholarships.criteria_text: Derby graduate of any undergraduate or postgraduate programme holding an MBA offer. Requires a CV, academic reference, personal statement and supporting statement.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated; applied for through an online form.
scholarships.notes: Open only to Derby graduates. Page lists no countries. Intake and deadline not stated.
